text: {"assertions":["A hang-on-exit bug in cli/commands/deploy.py was caused by a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The hang-on-exit bug only manifested when two requests raced on the same key.","The fix for the deploy command hang involved removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion.","A test assertion was added in tests/cli/test_deploy.py to verify that listeners are properly removed during teardown.","The deploy hang fix was submitted in PR #3721 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The hang-on-exit fix eliminated 64 duplicate rows per day that were previously being written.","The deploy command is part of the developer tooling side of the Python codebase."]}
